description: PR-9 — PD13 cost transparency + generation cache scaffolding. Audit items #41 (structured-output retry with diagnostic), #42 (token budget transparency), #43 (generation cache by hash key), #76 (PII redaction in telemetry — partial). Branch: big-bang/pr-9-cost-transparency-cache.
steps: BRANCH: Create branch big-bang/pr-9-cost-transparency-cache from main via `git -C /projects/sandbox/send-assistant checkout -b big-bang/pr-9-cost-transparency-cache`.

shared/aiSchemas.ts — inside WorksheetOutputSchema.metadata z.object(), append three new optional fields after the `reteach` field (around line 275 — the last field before the closing `}).optional()`): `costEstimate: z.object({ promptTokens: z.number().int().min(0), completionTokens: z.number().int().min(0), estimatedUsd: z.number().min(0), provider: z.string(), model: z.string() }).optional()`, `cacheKey: z.string().max(256).optional()`, `cacheHit: z.boolean().optional()`. All three are optional so older worksheets keep rendering.

client/src/lib/aiCostEstimate.ts (NEW) — pure helper module. Export `PROVIDER_PRICE_TABLE` (a readonly Record keyed by 'openai' | 'anthropic' | 'groq' | 'gemini' | 'openrouter' | 'cerebras' | 'sambanova' | 'mistral' | 'cohere' | 'nvidia_nim' with per-1k-token promptUsd + completionUsd entries based on publicly documented pricing as of mid-2026). Export `estimateCost(provider: string, model: string, promptTokens: number, completionTokens: number): { estimatedUsd: number; provider: string; model: string; promptTokens: number; completionTokens: number }`. No I/O. Falls back gracefully to $0 estimate when provider is unknown.

client/src/lib/aiCacheKey.ts (NEW) — pure deterministic hash module. Export `CACHE_RELEVANT_FIELDS = ['subject','topic','yearGroup','examBoard','sendNeed','generatorVersion','tier'] as const`. Export `buildCacheInput(fields: Record<string, string | null | undefined>): string` that JSON-serialises only the CACHE_RELEVANT_FIELDS subset in sorted key order (so key order in input is irrelevant), trimming and lowercasing each value. Export `hashCacheInput(input: string): string` — a pure djb2-style 32-bit hash returning a 8-char lowercase hex string (no crypto API, no Node built-ins, works in both browser and Node). Export `computeCacheKey(fields: Record<string, string | null | undefined>): string` that composes the two above. No I/O.

server/lib/generationCache.ts (NEW) — server-side cache wrapper. Imports `computeCacheKey` from `../../client/src/lib/aiCacheKey.js`. Disabled by default behind `GENERATION_CACHE_ENABLED=1` env flag (export `const CACHE_ENABLED = process.env.GENERATION_CACHE_ENABLED === '1'`). In-memory LRU: a `Map<string, { ws: unknown; insertedAt: number; hits: number }>` with a max of 200 entries (evict the oldest when over capacity). Export `getCached(key: string): unknown | null` — returns null when CACHE_ENABLED is false or key not found; updates hit count. Export `setCached(key: string, ws: unknown, ttlMs = 3_600_000): void` — no-op when CACHE_ENABLED is false. Export `redactPii(ws: unknown): unknown` — a pure function that deep-clones the worksheet (via JSON parse/stringify) and strips pupil names and IEP content: sets `metadata.pupilName` to `'[redacted]'` if present, removes `metadata.iepTargets`, removes `metadata.reteach.pupilsTargeted` if present. Export `cacheStats(): { size: number; enabled: boolean }`. No DB import needed for the LRU tier (schema.sql supplies the DDL for a future persistent tier).

server/db/schema.sql — append (before the end of file) the generation_cache DDL: `-- ── Generation Cache (PR-9 — generation cache by hash key) ──────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS generation_cache (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  inserted_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  hits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gen_cache_inserted ON generation_cache(inserted_at);`. Migration is idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS).

server/routes/ai.ts — wire cache into the `/generate` endpoint (line 610). At the START of the try block (after the content-filter safeguarding check and before the callWithFallback call): (1) extract cache-relevant fields from `req.body` (subject, topic, yearGroup, examBoard, sendNeed, generatorVersion, tier), (2) call `computeCacheKey(fields)` and store as `const cacheKey`, (3) call `getCached(cacheKey)` — if hit, stamp `metadata.cacheHit = true` and `metadata.cacheKey = cacheKey` on the cached worksheet and return it as `res.json({ content: cachedContent, provider: 'cache', cacheHit: true })`. On cache miss, after getting the LLM result: (4) call `setCached(cacheKey, redactPii(resultObj))` to write the cache. Also add `import { getCached, setCached, redactPii } from '../lib/generationCache.js'` and `import { computeCacheKey } from '../../client/src/lib/aiCacheKey.js'` to the top of ai.ts. Keep changes narrow — only the `/generate` endpoint is touched; do NOT rewrite other endpoints.

server/tests/generationCache.test.ts (NEW) — vitest test file. Import `computeCacheKey`, `buildCacheInput`, `hashCacheInput`, `CACHE_RELEVANT_FIELDS` from `../../client/src/lib/aiCacheKey`. Import `estimateCost`, `PROVIDER_PRICE_TABLE` from `../../client/src/lib/aiCostEstimate`. Import `getCached`, `setCached`, `redactPii`, `cacheStats`, `CACHE_ENABLED` from `../lib/generationCache`. Write describe blocks: (A) aiCacheKey — same input always gives same key, key order does not matter, different topic gives different key, unknown fields are ignored, empty/null values are handled; (B) aiCostEstimate — openai estimate is > 0, groq estimate is > 0, unknown provider returns 0, zero tokens returns 0, promptTokens and completionTokens are correctly reflected in return; (C) generationCache in-memory LRU — getCached returns null for unknown key, setCached then getCached round-trips correctly, hit count increments, cacheStats reflects size, redactPii strips pupilName and iepTargets, redactPii strips reteach.pupilsTargeted, redactPii leaves other fields intact.
SESSION-HANDOFF.md — move PR-9 from 'What is next' to 'What is in flight'.
acceptance_criteria: shared/aiSchemas.ts WorksheetOutputSchema.metadata now contains costEstimate, cacheKey, and cacheHit fields, all optional.
client/src/lib/aiCostEstimate.ts exists and exports estimateCost and PROVIDER_PRICE_TABLE.
client/src/lib/aiCacheKey.ts exists and exports computeCacheKey, buildCacheInput, hashCacheInput, CACHE_RELEVANT_FIELDS.
server/lib/generationCache.ts exists and exports getCached, setCached, redactPii, cacheStats, CACHE_ENABLED.
server/db/schema.sql contains the generation_cache CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statement.
server/routes/ai.ts imports getCached/setCached/redactPii from generationCache and computeCacheKey from aiCacheKey.
server/tests/generationCache.test.ts exists and all tests pass under vitest.
verification: pnpm run check (tsc --noEmit) — must produce zero errors.
pnpm test -- --reporter=verbose 2>&1 | grep -E 'PASS|FAIL|generationCache' — the generationCache.test.ts suite must show all tests passing.
